logs.subject: The world has discovered Kloof Street
logs.body:
Hi Zaheer,

The world has discovered Kloof Street. Let's make sure you benefit from that too.

More people are discovering the street before they arrive, using kloofstreet.online to decide where to eat, shop, unwind and spend their money.

Already listed? Claim your profile. It takes about two minutes, it's free, and it puts you in control of how your business appears on the guide.
